# WMFB port notice

Original method and toolbox: Samuel Boudet and the FHRMA contributors,

helpers in the FHRMA toolbox, licensed GPL-3.0. `COPYING` is the unmodified

This file is a previously maintained local Python translation, adapted to the

Scientific reference: S. Boudet et al., weighted-median-filter FHR baseline

No dataset is included. This directory is independent of the first-party wheel;
